intent.instructions: Which action should the player take for the next second to survive and reach the level exit? Bearings are in degrees relative to where the player faces: negative is left, positive is right. Distances are map units. walls gives the distance to the nearest wall in eight directions; a closed door counts as a wall, and under 48 the player is pressed against it, so walking forward does nothing. route is the way to the exit: head for route.bearing, and route.via says whether the next point is an opening (portal), a door, or the exit switch itself. use_target is what the use action would do right now; it is null when there is nothing to use. A closed door only opens with use, and pressing use again while it is still opening closes it, so after opening a door advance through it. interactables lists nearby doors, switches and the exit; locked means a key the player does not hold.

criteria.advance: Walk forward when route.bearing is within about 15 degrees and walls.ahead is above 48, or to go through a door that has just been opened
criteria.turn_left: Rotate left to face route.bearing, an enemy, or the open side when a wall is dead ahead
criteria.turn_right: Rotate right to face route.bearing, an enemy, or the open side when a wall is dead ahead
criteria.strafe_left: Sidestep left to dodge fire or to slide past a corner or pillar
criteria.strafe_right: Sidestep right to dodge fire or to slide past a corner or pillar
criteria.retreat: Back away from enemies, or toward a health pickup. Never to get past a wall
criteria.use: Press use only when use_target is a closed door that is not locked, or the exit switch. Not when it is null

threat.instructions: Is an enemy likely to damage the player within the next two seconds?

criteria.true: An enemy has line of sight, is within attack range, or is closing in.
criteria.false: No enemy has line of sight, or all are far away and not approaching.

danger.instructions: How dangerous is the player's situation right now?
criteria: Safe: no enemies in view and health above 70
Watchful: enemies in view but far away, health above 50
Engaged: enemies in range, health above 30
Pressured: several enemies in range, or health 30 or below
Critical: health 15 or below with enemies in range
